description: Stock systemd PID1/services/journal, repeated original containerd shim startup, and Docker default runc/overlay2/bridge/seccomp with offline image, exec, DNS, volumes and daemon restart.

cases.script:
exec /usr/bin/python3 - <<'CHECK'
import json, os, socket, struct, subprocess, time
from pathlib import Path

def varint(value):
    out = bytearray()
    while value > 127:
        out.append((value & 127) | 128)
        value >>= 7
    return bytes(out) + bytes([value])

def field(number, value):
    return varint(number << 3 | 2) + varint(len(value)) + value

def fields(data):
    at = 0
    def integer():
        nonlocal at
        value = shift = 0
        while True:
            assert at < len(data) and shift < 70, 'invalid protobuf varint'
            byte = data[at]; at += 1
            value |= (byte & 127) << shift
            if byte < 128: return value
            shift += 7
    result = {}
    while at < len(data):
        tag = integer(); kind = tag & 7; number = tag >> 3
        assert number and kind in (0, 2), 'unexpected protobuf field'
        if kind == 0: value = integer()
        else:
            length = integer(); assert at + length <= len(data), 'short protobuf field'
            value = data[at:at+length]; at += length
        result[number] = value
    return result

def rpc(address, method, payload):
    request = field(1, b'containerd.task.v2.Task') + field(2, method.encode()) + field(3, payload)
    with socket.socket(socket.AF_UNIX, socket.SOCK_STREAM) as peer:
        peer.settimeout(10)
        peer.connect(address)
        peer.sendall(struct.pack('>IIBB', len(request), 1, 1, 0) + request)
        def receive(length):
            data = b''
            while len(data) < length:
                chunk = peer.recv(length-len(data))
                assert chunk, 'unexpected TTRPC EOF'
                data += chunk
            return data
        length, stream, kind, flags = struct.unpack('>IIBB', receive(10))
        assert stream == 1 and kind == 2 and flags == 0 and length <= 4 << 20, 'invalid TTRPC response'
        response = fields(receive(length))
        status = fields(response.get(1, b'')).get(1, 0)
        assert status == 0, ('TTRPC error', method, status)
        return response.get(2, b'')

os.makedirs('/run/containerd', exist_ok=True)
rows = []
for i in range(20):
    ident = 'trames-shim-' + str(i)
    work = Path('/work') / ident
    work.mkdir()
    (work/'config.json').write_text('{"annotations":{}}')
    os.mkfifo(work/'log')
    log = os.open(work/'log', os.O_RDWR | os.O_NONBLOCK)
    row = dict(iteration=i, stage='starting')
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/containerd-shim-runc-v2', '-namespace', 'moby', '-id', ident,
                                 '-address', '/run/containerd/containerd.sock', 'start'],
                                cwd=work, input=b'', capture_output=True, timeout=20)
        row.update(starter=result.returncode, stderr=result.stderr.decode(errors='replace'))
        assert result.returncode == 0, row
        address = result.stdout.decode().strip().removeprefix('unix://')
        row['stage'] = 'connect-rpc'
        payload = field(1, ident.encode())
        pid = fields(rpc(address, 'Connect', payload)).get(1, 0)
        assert pid > 1 and ident.encode() in (Path('/proc')/str(pid)/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0'), 'original live shim'
        row.update(initialized=True, pid=pid, stage='shutdown-rpc')
        assert rpc(address, 'Shutdown', payload) == b'', 'empty Shutdown response'
        row['stage'] = 'reap'
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 20
        while True:
            child, status = os.waitpid(pid, os.WNOHANG)
            if child: break
            assert time.monotonic() < deadline, 'shim did not exit after Shutdown RPC'
            time.sleep(.01)
        assert child == pid and status == 0, ('shim exit', child, status)
        row.update(status=status, stage='complete')
    finally:
        os.close(log)
        rows.append(row)
        Path('/work/shim-startup.log').write_text(json.dumps(rows, indent=2) + '\n')
Path('/work/shim-startup.result').write_text('shim-startup: ok\n')
CHECK
